restaurant_name: LDC Dental ราชพฤกษ์
text:
Convenient, close to home, and the doctor is lovely.
I finished my orthodontic treatment here a year ago, and I still come for checkups because the doctor is so lovely, explains things well, and is very thorough.

Before getting braces, I consulted with several places. Personally, I trusted the reasonable price and the doctor I could communicate with.
Ultimately, I decided to get braces here because the doctor explains things in detail and gives good advice. They don't force you to do everything perfectly,
but rather prioritize your convenience. I was able to ask questions and get advice to help me make decisions.

Most recently, I had my crowns replaced. Everything happened so quickly – removing the old ones and installing the new ones.
It was done surprisingly fast, but the new ones are more comfortable than the old ones. I'm surprisingly impressed, so I haven't gone anywhere else.
